name: web_url_scheme
description: Choose HTTP versus HTTPS scheme from whether a web connection uses TLS; distinguish scheme from hostname copying.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
hosts=['example.org','news.net','shop.com','docs.org','portal.net','school.edu','library.org','weather.com']
for i in range(96):
 host=random.choice(hosts); secure=bool(i%2)
 desc=random.choice(['uses TLS encryption','is encrypted with TLS','requires a secure HTTPS connection']) if secure else random.choice(['uses plain HTTP without TLS','is unencrypted HTTP','uses HTTP with no encryption'])
 p=f'A web server at {host} {desc}. '
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Write only the URL scheme before ://. Scheme:', 'answer':' '+('https' if secure else 'http')})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Write only the hostname. Hostname:', 'answer':' '+host})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
